title: Universal circuit size bound
statement: Every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet is recognized by a family of circuits with fan-in at most two whose circuit on inputs of length $n$ has size at most $40\cdot 2^n/(n+1)$ for every $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
